verdict.rationale: Docs claim the Crossplane CLI supports 'testing and rendering standalone Composition Functions without the need to access a Kubernetes cluster running Crossplane' (crossplane-docs-7), suggesting a test-without-production workflow. However, hands-on probe evidence states that unlike other tools, every real plan/apply operation with Crossplane requires a running Kubernetes cluster with the control plane installed, with no local plan/preview loop existing, contradicting the ease of isolated testing.
